items.title: How to Thrive in an AI-Driven Future
items.summary: In episode 1011 of the SuperDataScience podcast, Jon Krohn discusses with Dr. Catherine Williams, Chief Data Officer at Candid how to set oneself up for success in the LLM-enabled future. Dr. Williams advises investing in one's own mental models and retaining information, emphasizing that professionals should grow along with AI rather than outsourcing their intellectual development entirely.

items.title: The Core Components of a Serious AI Agent System
items.summary:
A real AI agent system is more than a prompt connected to an LLM.

In this Short, Micheal Lanham, author of AI Agents in Action, Second Edition, breaks down the core components behind serious agent systems: models, tools, memory, planning, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and safeguards.

Learn more about the book: https://hubs.la/Q04p-7WX0

#AIAgents #AgenticAI #AIEngineering #LLM #ManningBooks

items.title: Why Most Enterprise AI Projects Never Scale | Ft. Vikas Bhalla, EXL
items.summary:
EXL's President of AI Operations, Vikas Bhalla, breaks down why most enterprise AI projects stall, and what it actually takes to move from pilots to production at scale.

In this episode of the Simulated Reality Podcast, Vikas Bhalla maps four stages of AI evolution, shares EXL's playbook across insurance, healthcare, and banking, and makes the case that enterprise AI success has nothing to do with the technology stack.
